I feel like the Knicks are in their heads too much, overthinking things. I’d like to see them make quicker decisions and play more on instinct.

13 for 41 from three. That's how you lose in Philly 🧱 The Knicks drop a 98-93 NBA Cup grinder to the Sixers. Brunson 24 on 8-22, KAT 22 and 12, Maxey 27 for Philly. Knicks fall to 2-4. Nets lose 110-94 to Detroit, now 0-5. Long night in NY. via ESPN #Knicks #Nets #SKAYPGroup

Said it before and I’ll say it again, 76ers are a very good team this season.

They didn’t even have Brown tonight and Embiid was subpar, so was KAT. Their bench looks underrated.

You gotta be at your very best to beat them and Knicks simply weren’t tonight.

The Knicks are now 0-2 against Philly and 0-1 against Boston…It’s early as hell in a long season but these things matter when it comes to tiebreakers man. Mike Brown gotta pull a whole new set of strings to get this thing going right.
